#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Script to create feature tables customers12050b v1 and v2"""

import hopsworks
import pandas as pd

# Login to Hopsworks
hopsworks.login()

# Get the current project and feature store
proj = hopsworks.get_current_project()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

print("Creating feature table customers12050b version 1...")

# Create version 1 with initial export
# Schema: row_id (string), name (string), balance_eur (double), updated_at (bigint)
fg_v1 = fs.create_feature_group(
    name='customers12050b',
    version=1,
    description='Initial export of customers table',
    primary_key=['row_id'],
    event_time='updated_at',
    online_enabled=False
)

# Read initial export
df_v1 = pd.read_csv('data/initial_export.csv')
print(f"Initial export shape: {df_v1.shape}")
print(f"Initial export columns: {list(df_v1.columns)}")

# Save version 1
fg_v1.save(df_v1)
print("Version 1 saved successfully!")

print("\nCreating feature table customers12050b version 2...")

# Create version 2 with new export
# Schema: row_id (string), full_name (string), balance (double), currency (string), updated_at (bigint)
fg_v2 = fs.create_feature_group(
    name='customers12050b',
    version=2,
    description='New export after breaking schema change',
    primary_key=['row_id'],
    event_time='updated_at',
    online_enabled=True  # Enable online/real-time access
)

# Read new export
df_v2 = pd.read_csv('data/reload/new_export.csv')
print(f"New export shape: {df_v2.shape}")
print(f"New export columns: {list(df_v2.columns)}")

# Save version 2
fg_v2.save(df_v2)
print("Version 2 saved successfully!")

# Verify both versions exist
print("\nVerifying feature groups...")
fg1_check = fs.get_feature_group('customers12050b', version=1)
print(f"Version 1 exists: {fg1_check.name} v{fg1_check.version}")

fg2_check = fs.get_feature_group('customers12050b', version=2)
print(f"Version 2 exists: {fg2_check.name} v{fg2_check.version}")
print(f"Version 2 online enabled: {fg2_check.online_enabled}")

print("\nDone! Feature tables created successfully.")
